steps.title: Create the disrupter CSS file
steps.description: Create assets/component-collection-disrupter.css with CSS Grid overrides for .product-grid--has-disrupter and all disrupter block styling including sticky image, responsive spans, and optional text overlay.

steps.title: Create the disrupter Liquid snippet
steps.description: Create snippets/collection-disrupter.liquid with the disrupter markup: sticky image wrapper, responsive image tag with srcset, optional heading and link overlay.

steps.title: Add conditional CSS loading to the section
steps.description: At the top of sections/main-collection-product-grid.liquid, detect whether a disrupter block exists and conditionally load component-collection-disrupter.css.

steps.title: Add CSS Grid class to the product grid container
steps.description: On the <ul id='product-grid'> element, conditionally add the class 'product-grid--has-disrupter' when a disrupter block is present.

steps.title: Modify the product loop to insert the disrupter
steps.description: Replace the product for-loop to insert the disrupter <li> at the configured position. The disrupter <li> gets class 'grid__item--disrupter' and renders the collection-disrupter snippet.

steps.title: Add disrupter block definition to the section schema
steps.description: Add a 'blocks' array to the schema with a 'disrupter' block type (limit: 1) containing settings for image_picker, position range, heading text, link_url, and link_text.

steps.title: Test and verify
steps.description: Verify: disrupter renders at correct position, sticky image works, responsive breakpoints behave correctly, grid without disrupter is unchanged, animations still cascade properly.

technical_context.why_css_grid: Flexbox cannot span items across multiple rows and columns simultaneously. CSS Grid is required for the 2col × 3row disrupter span.
technical_context.conversion_strategy: Only the product grid with a disrupter converts to CSS Grid via .product-grid--has-disrupter class. The base .grid flexbox class in base.css is NOT modified. This ensures zero regression on other grids site-wide.
technical_context.sticky_mechanism: position:sticky on the image wrapper works because the parent <li> (grid-row: span 3) is taller than the viewport-height image. As the user scrolls, the image pins to top:0 until the parent's bottom edge passes.

responsive_layout.tablet_750_989: 2-col grid, disrupter spans 2 col × 2 row (full width)
responsive_layout.mobile_under_750: 2-col grid, disrupter spans full width × 1 row, no sticky
